neighbours.label: the token ' pale' / 'Pale' (pale colour, and the 'Pale' piece of Palestine, Paleo- names)
fire: Her face went pale when she read the letter from the bank.
The walls were painted a pale shade of blue that made the room feel larger.
He looked tired and pale after spending a week in the hospital.
We ordered two pints of pale ale and a plate of chips.
The morning sky was pale and grey above the harbour.
Pale yellow flowers grew along the edge of the old stone wall.
The negotiations between Israel and the Palestinian leadership stalled again.
The paleontologist carefully brushed dust from the fossil bone.
quiet: Her face went red when she read the letter from the bank.
The walls were painted a soft shade of blue that made the room feel larger.
He looked tired and thin after spending a week in the hospital.
We ordered two pints of dark beer and a plate of chips.
The morning sky was cloudy and grey above the harbour.
Bright yellow flowers grew along the edge of the old stone wall.
The negotiations between Israel and its neighbours stalled again.
The geologist carefully brushed dust from the ancient rock.

notes: card: ' pale' x15, ' Pale' x9, 'Pale' x4 of top 32; fires on the piece regardless of meaning (Palestine, Palecek, paleo).
